newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - March 13.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Huge market in Abidjan's Adjame suburb to be cleared from March 15 and demolished after April 1 so complex can be rebuilt; the 2,500 recognised traders there to be temporarily resited pending completion of project by end of April 1998
- Government decree liberalising imports of second-hand buses and trucks likely to increase danger on the roads, operators say
- UNICAO cocoa processing plant in Vridi to increase annual production to 86,000 tonnes of beans from October, chairman of parent company SIFCOM says; current capacity is 65,000 tonnes
